item.title: Crossing boundaries: AUS' Christianna Bonin curates Art Dubai Modern
item.description: American University of Sharjah’s Dr. Christianna Bonin, Assistant Professor of Art History and Theory in the College of Architecture, Art and Design (CAAD), is curating the Art Dubai Modern section as part of this year’s Art Dubai.

item.title: American University of Sharjah to showcase climate credentials in lead-up to COP28
item.description: American University of Sharjah (AUS) is preparing for an exciting few months ahead as it readies itself for COP28, having been named as a member of the COP28 University Taskforce by the UAE Special Climate Envoy to COP28.

item.title: AUS students gain real-world experience with UPS
item.description: For American University of Sharjah (AUS) students Bardia Shojae and Liana Hajeir, gaining valuable first-hand professional skills during their internship at UPS in the UAE, proved to be a rewarding experience.

item.title: AUS students win first place at World Federation of Engineering Organizations’ Hackathon with smart energy solution for climate-resilient cities
item.description: At a time when cities around the world are searching for smarter and more sustainable infrastructure, three students from American University of Sharjah (AUS) have shown how engineering can offer practical answers.

item.title: AUS hosts captivating TEDx talks on leadership, resilience and growth
item.description: American University of Sharjah (AUS) welcomed back the TEDx stage with a program that moved past easy definitions of achievement and into the qualities that actually sustain it.

item.title: Engineering excellence celebrated at CEN Honors Convocation
item.description: The College of Engineering (CEN) at American University of Sharjah (AUS) held its annual Honors Convocation on February 10, recognizing undergraduate students whose academic achievements reflect dedication, discipline and excellence.

item.title: AUS brings physical AI to campus through new robotics partnership with Terminus Group
item.description: Two advanced robots have arrived at American University of Sharjah's (AUS) Department of Computer Science and Engineering, thanks to a partnership with Terminus Group.
